During the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] '''raided''' a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Multiple pirate [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] were shot down before [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] leader [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ordered that the pirates be allowed to escape.<ref name="XWRS28" />
